Name: Kenaz, Father of Othniel
Summary: Kenaz is named only as the father of Othniel, Israel's first judge, and as the brother of Caleb. He is distinct from Kenaz, son of Eliphaz, in Genesis.
KeyStory: Kenaz appears as Othniel's father when Othniel takes Kirjath-sepher and marries Achsah, and again when Othniel becomes judge.
LifeLesson: The first judge's father is remembered in two verses.
